vocabulary.meaning_en: to pick up the phone when it rings and speak
vocabulary.example: Please answer the phone with the company name.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a phone conversation; to phone someone
vocabulary.example: I had a call from a client this morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to press the numbers on a phone
vocabulary.example: Dial 9 first to get an outside line.

vocabulary.meaning_en: free to talk or meet now
vocabulary.example: The manager is not available at the moment.
She's in a meeting at the moment.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to write down information for someone who isn't there
vocabulary.example: He's out. Can I take a message?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to phone someone again, or return their call
vocabulary.example: Shall I ask him to call you back?

vocabulary.meaning_en: having a lot to do; not free
vocabulary.example: I'm afraid she's busy right now.
Just saying "Yes?" when you answer is rude.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a time when you learn and practise a skill
vocabulary.example: We have a training session on customer service today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: doing something again and again to improve
vocabulary.note_ar: بريطاني: practice اسم و practise فعل

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say your name and who you are
vocabulary.example: When you call, first introduce yourself.

vocabulary.meaning_en: friendly enough to use each other's first names
vocabulary.meaning_ar: على علاقة تسمح بالمناداة بالاسم الأول
vocabulary.example: We've worked together for years, so we're on first name terms.

vocabulary.meaning_en: about your private life, not work
vocabulary.note_en: Stress on the first part: PER-son-al.
vocabulary.example: Please don't make personal calls during work time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the people who work for a company; staff
vocabulary.note_en: Stress on the last part: per-son-NEL.
vocabulary.example: Talk to personnel about your holiday days.
I get nervous when I speak on the phone in English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: worried because of too much pressure
vocabulary.example: She's stressed because of all the work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way you speak to people on the phone
vocabulary.example: Anna had an excellent phone manner this time.

fine_lines.title: personal vs personnel
fine_lines.explanation_ar: personal صفة تعني شخصي/خاص، والنبر على أولها. personnel اسم يعني الموظفين أو قسم شؤون الموظفين، والنبر على آخرها. خلطت آنا بينهما في الحلقة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Personal" (adjective) means private, stress at the start. "Personnel" (noun) means the staff of a company, stress at the end. Anna mixed them up in this episode.

examples.sentence: All personnel must wear a badge.

fine_lines.title: I'm sorry vs I'm afraid
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلتاهما طريقة مهذبة لإعطاء خبر غير مرغوب. I'm afraid هنا لا تعني الخوف بل تعني "للأسف".
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both politely give unwelcome news. Here "I'm afraid" does not mean fear; it means "unfortunately".

examples.sentence: I'm really sorry, he's not available.

expressions.phrase: Hello? Tip Top Trading. This is Anna speaking.
expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا؟ شركة تِب توب تريدينغ. معك آنا.
expressions.meaning_en: answering with the company name and your name
expressions.example: Hello? Green Office Supplies. This is Omar speaking.

expressions.meaning_en: a short way to answer with your name

expressions.phrase: Hello Mrs Smith, how can I help you?
expressions.meaning_ar: مرحبًا سيدة سميث، كيف يمكنني مساعدتك؟
expressions.meaning_en: used after the caller says who they are
expressions.example: Hello Mr Khan, how can I help you?

expressions.phrase: Hello Mrs Smith, how are you?
expressions.meaning_en: used when you already know the caller
expressions.example: Oh, hello Mr Brown, how are you?

expressions.phrase: I'm really sorry, he's not available at the moment. Can I take a message?
expressions.meaning_ar: أنا آسف جدًا، هو غير متاح حاليًا. هل يمكنني أخذ رسالة؟
expressions.meaning_en: used when the person the caller wants isn't there
expressions.example: I'm really sorry, she's not available at the moment. Can I take a message?

expressions.phrase: I'm afraid he's busy – shall I ask him to call you back?
expressions.meaning_ar: للأسف هو مشغول، هل أطلب منه أن يعاود الاتصال بك؟
expressions.meaning_en: offering a call back when someone is busy
expressions.example: I'm afraid she's busy – shall I ask her to call you back?

expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to end a call
expressions.example: OK, I'll tell him. Thank you for calling, goodbye.

expressions.phrase: I'd like to speak to... please.
expressions.meaning_en: used by the caller to ask for someone
expressions.example: I'd like to speak to the manager, please.

expressions.meaning_en: said by a caller who will phone again
expressions.example: That's OK, I'll try again later.

grammar.title: Offers with Shall I...? and Can I...?
grammar.explanation_ar: لعرض المساعدة بأدب على الهاتف نستخدم Shall I + الفعل الأساسي أو Can I + الفعل الأساسي. Shall I أكثر رسمية وتستخدم كثيرًا في الإنجليزية البريطانية.
grammar.explanation_en: To offer help politely on the phone, use "Shall I + base verb?" or "Can I + base verb?". "Shall I" is a little more formal and common in British English.
examples: Shall I ask him to call you back?
Shall I give you her email address?

questions.question: What is the best way to answer the phone at work?
choices: Hello? Tip Top Trading. Anna speaking.
questions.explanation_en: Say the company name and your name politely.

questions.question: Complete: He's not available at the moment. Can I ___ a message?
Complete: ___ I ask him to call you back?
questions.explanation_en: "Shall I...?" is used to offer help.

questions.question: Which word means "the staff of a company"?
Which phrase ends a phone call politely?
You already know the caller. What do you say?
choices: Hello Mrs Smith, how are you?
questions.explanation_ar: إذا كنت تعرف المتصل تسأله عن حاله.
questions.explanation_en: If you know the caller, ask how they are.

questions.question: Why did Denise say "Yes?" was wrong?
choices: It is in the wrong language
questions.explanation_ar: قول Yes فقط عند الرد غير مهذب.

questions.question: "We're on first name terms" means...
choices: We use each other's first names
questions.explanation_en: It means we call each other by first names.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Shall I to take a message?
questions.explanation_ar: بعد Shall I يأتي الفعل الأساسي.
questions.explanation_en: After "Shall I" use the base verb.
